citations.evidence: When a stalled PR blocks dependent work, you add that work to the same PR — making it larger, slower to review, and harder to merge
No PR is independently mergeable... Small total diffs — a 200-line change sliced into three 60-line PRs adds queue overhead without lowering per-PR load.
Grep is the baseline to beat, not file reading... If a single grep pins the symbol, the LSP round-trip rarely pays for itself.
Execution environment | Did the agent waste context on broken dev setup, missing deps, or wrong tool versions?
Checkpoints that only inspect the agent's own narration, such as "I fixed the bug" or "all tests pass", are easy to fool.
Accepting agent output as correct because it looks polished — without independent verification.
Task specification | Did the prompt define a verifiable goal, or did the agent have to guess?
Agents do not reliably follow pointers... The docs/ directory is drafted by an agent rather than maintained by humans.
"third-party and local development marketplaces have auto-update disabled by default"... the artifact that executes is the lifecycle-hook configuration
